dogecoin.text: Through this new integration between Flexa and AurusPay, even more merchants can now seamlessly enable instant acceptance for dozens of digital currencies—including bitcoin, ether, litecoin, dogecoin, and more.

This new integration between Flexa and InComm Payments will enable more merchants to access acceptance of digital currencies—including bitcoin, dogecoin, litecoin, and zcash—than ever before. Stay tuned for more as we roll out this integration over the coming months!
